scoring_justification: The scored artifacts contain only final computed numeric values (friction stresses, beta, tau_c, k). No intermediate raw artifacts are scored, so a full recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible; instead the reported numbers are compared to the paper's reported values with linear tolerance decay, per the approved plan.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for friction shear stresses, Labusch parameter, critical unpinning stress, and Hall-Petch slope
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper sections 4.2–4.4 (tau0_edge=5.4 MN/m², tau0_screw=3.1 MN/m², beta≈7, tau0_screw_low=9.5 MN/m², τc≈0.03G, k=0.33 MN/m^{3/2}). τc was recomputed as 1449 MN/m² from G=48.3 GPa, b=0.256 nm, h=√6 b/2, b_e=√3 b/6, λ=b. These are the paper's actual reported numbers, consistent with the reference solver.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Taken verbatim from paper text and verified by recalculating the expressions with stated parameters. The solver's hardcoded values match these numbers exactly.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values from the paper's theoretical discussion, traceable to the formulas and constants. The task's gold is the paper's own result, not invented.

outputs.description: Friction shear stresses from the Nabarro model for dissociated edge and screw partials at moderate temperature.
Labusch parameter and Fridel-model friction stress for a dissociated screw dislocation at low temperature.
Critical unpinning shear stress and predicted Hall-Petch slope k for the Cu-Cd alloy.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are to be placed in /app/outputs. The hidden checker compares the reported numeric values to paper-derived reference values using absolute tolerances. The load-bearing step (step_03) ensures that the intermediate process step (step_00) has been executed.
